Name: (AT) Moss's Gingerbread Farmhouse 3
Author: MossiMods
Description:
[center][b][color=#e69138][size=5][font=Georgia]Gingerbread Houses - 2 Winter Variants for Farmhouse 3[/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]



[b][color=#f6b26b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/color][/b]
Unzip the file into your mods folder

In game during [b][i]WINTER[/i][/b] use the Paint Bucket Tool on your farmhouse's Exterior to choose one 
of these variants

[b][color=#f6b26b][size=4]Main features[/size][/color][/b]
2 Winter Season Variants of Farmhouse 3 (the largest Farmhouse, upgrade with Robin the Carpenter)
to make your Farmhouse into a cute, festive Gingerbread house!
[b][color=#00ff00]NO AI USED TO CREATE MY MODS[/color][/b] - Every Mod I make is drawn pixel by pixel

[color=#e69138][size=5][b]TIPS:[/b][/size][/color]
[b]If you want to get things built quickly , use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url]

First, Go to the Carpenter on a day and time she is open. Opening the Menu to choose which building to construct will tell you
how much Gold and how many of each material you need to build each building and its upgrade

Use the Item Spawner - Hit "I" on your keyboard and type the item you want into the search bar to instantly spawn it.
example: type in "paint bucket" to get the paint bucket, "wood" to find wood

Now hit "P" on your keyboard to enter the Cheats Menu. 
Go to the "Farm and Fishing" Tab and check the "Instant Build" Box to get buildings from Robin Built Instantly instead of waiting days.
In the "Player and Tools" Tab, scroll down and you can add as much gold as you need to complete a build.
You can also use the Cheats menu to instantly Warp to Robin when you need to using the Warp Locations tab. [/b]

[b][color=#f6b26b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/color][/b]
Alternative Textures
